name: hardened-banking-platform
description: Hardened Banking Platform Monorepo — Single centralized .env via dotenvx

scripts.dev:web: dotenvx run --env-file=.env -- bash -c "cd web-app && next dev -p 3000"
scripts.dev:mobile: dotenvx run --env-file=.env -- bash -c "cd ExpoBankingApp && npx expo start"
scripts.dev: npm run env:check && npm run dev:db && concurrently --names "backend,web,mobile" -c "blue,green,yellow" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:mobile"
